name: Suki Desu Suzuki-kun!! 4nin no Suzuki-kun
original_name: 好きです鈴木くん!! 4人の鈴木くん
source:
Based on the manga by Gou Ikeyamada.

The player can choose to play as either Chihiro or Sayaka. The game follows an original story not present in the manga, where the main cast visits a vacation villa on summer holidays and encounter two other Suzukis.
